title: AI Transformation Strategy & Roadmap
bullets: Proposal to Qamar Logistics Group
Submitted by Meridian Advisory | October 2026
notes: Welcome the Qamar Logistics team and introduce the purpose of today's proposal presentation.

title: About Meridian Advisory
bullets: We are a specialized consultancy focused on emerging technology strategies and operational excellence.
Our firm's foundation rests on unwavering integrity and absolute ethical standards.
We champion responsible conduct in every professional interaction and internal practice.
notes: Highlight our core values of integrity and responsible conduct as the bedrock of our firm.

title: Our understanding of your context
bullets: Qamar Logistics faces rapid regional expansion across multiple transport and trade corridors.
Intense competition from agile, digital-first logistics players is compressing traditional margins.
Operations rely heavily on fragmented legacy systems that hinder centralized visibility.
notes: Reflect back Qamar's current market pressures and infrastructural hurdles.

title: Our approach at a glance
bullets: Diagnose: Assess current capabilities and technical baselines.
Discover: Identify and evaluate prospective high-value opportunities.
Design: Architect the operating structures and long-term trajectory.
Deliver: Build rapid prototypes to test viability in the field.
notes: Walk through the four sequential phases of our methodology without getting into timeline details.

title: Phase 1 - Diagnose
bullets: Evaluate readiness baselines across Ports, Freight, Warehousing, Customs Brokerage, and Corporate Services.
Conduct stakeholder interviews and execute a structured capability scorecard across divisions.
Audit technical data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and existing system integration frameworks.
notes: Detail our dual focus on operational division readiness and core technical infrastructure.

title: Phase 2 - Discover
bullets: Build a comprehensive long-list of 25+ AI opportunities spanning the entire enterprise footprint.
Score each opportunity rigorously based on business value versus ease of implementation.
Size each AI play with an indicative EBITDA uplift model to prioritize high-impact initiatives.
notes: Explain how we generate, evaluate, and financialize prospective AI plays.

title: Phase 3 - Design
bullets: Architect a centralized AI hub and define new technical roles like AI product owners and machine learning engineers.
Establish clear decision-making rights and accountability frameworks for enterprise artificial intelligence.
Develop a sequenced three-year roadmap structured into distinct execution waves.
notes: Outline the structural governance and phased roadmap design.

title: Phase 4 - Deliver
bullets: Construct two rapid minimum viable products targeting the highest-ranked operational opportunities.
Deploy prototypes with real frontline users to evaluate operational utility and user adoption.
Deliver a definitive go/no-go recommendation for full-scale enterprise deployment.
notes: Emphasize empirical testing through rapid prototyping before broad scaling.

title: Building AI capabilities
bullets: Design and execute tailored AI awareness workshops exclusively for the senior leadership team.
Align executive stakeholders on strategic priorities, risks, and artificial intelligence opportunities.
Foster executive fluency to ensure informed sponsorship of future technical initiatives.
notes: Clarify that capability building at this stage focuses strictly on senior leadership alignment.

title: What you will receive
bullets: A comprehensive baseline diagnostic report detailing today's operational and technical position.
A fully ranked opportunity portfolio complete with EBITDA impact sizing.
A final strategic presentation and executive briefing session with the Executive Board.
notes: Summarize the tangible outputs and executive-level deliverables from our engagement.

title: Workplan
bullets: Structured 16-week engagement plan designed for rapid insight generation and strategic delivery.
Includes a formal mid-point checkpoint with leadership sponsors in week 8.
notes: Review the high-level timeline and critical milestone review points.

Our professional fees are fully benchmarked against prevailing regional market rates for tier-one advisory.
notes: Outline the commercial terms, fixed phase pricing, and payment milestones.
